scope: tests/integration/handlers-new.test.ts (sandbox hooks and unique filename only)
intent: Isolate handler filesystem tests from the user's default diagrams directory with per-test temporary resources, deterministic cleanup, and worker-safe filenames.
advisory: The suites are intentionally non-concurrent within each Jest worker; separate files receive separate module environments and unique temporary directories.
The default-directory fingerprint covers BPMN files, which are the only files written by the scoped engine and handler operations.
